native.why: RadonPy's own default: width=2000 thermo rows on the full sampling log.

matched.why: Both arms truncated to their last 2001 rows (2 ns at 1 row/ps), width 800 = the same 40% of the window RadonPy's 2000/5001 uses. PolyJarvis production logs hold 2001 rows, where width 2000 leaves every sma_sd NaN and check_eq passes vacuously. A shorter rolling mean fluctuates more, so the matched window is stricter than native on BOTH arms equally.

path_roots.v1:: $POLYJARVIS_V1_ROOT, default ~/PolyJarvis -- the round-1 checkout that holds the PEG runs
